en: [[Children]] [[are]] [[more capable of learning multiple languages or adapting to new environments than adults]], so many parents enjoy watching their kids pick up new words so quickly.
me: more capable of learning multiple languages or adapting to new environments than adults
, so many parents enjoy watching their kids pick up new words so quickly
easy: of learning multiple languages or adapting to new environments than adults
어른보다 여러 언어를 배우거나 새 환경에 적응하는 데.
so many parents enjoy watching their kids pick up new words
그래서 많은 부모가 아이들이 새 단어를 익히는 것을 지켜보길 즐긴다.
요약: 아이들은 배우고 적응하는 힘이 커서, 부모는 그 모습을 보며 즐거워한다.
notes: enjoy + 동명사(-ing): enjoy watching(watch 지켜보다). to watch ✕
동명사만 목적어로 받는 동사: enjoy, avoid, finish, mind
pick up = (단어 등을) 익히다

en: When you first meet a German host, [[he]] [[will shake]] [[hands]], greet everyone standing there, and even bow his head slightly, and [[offer]] a small gift as a sign of respect.
me: When you first meet a German host,
, greet everyone standing there, and even bow his head slightly, and offer a small gift as a sign of respect
easy: When you first meet a German host
greet everyone standing there, and even bow his head slightly
그곳에 서 있는 모두에게 인사하고 심지어 고개도 살짝 숙인다.
offer a small gift as a sign of respect
요약: 독일 주최자는 악수, 인사, 고개 숙임, 작은 선물로 예의를 표한다.
notes: 조동사 will 뒤는 동사원형: shake(악수하다), greet(인사하다), bow(숙이다), offer(건네다)가 and로 나란히
offering(-ing)이면 will 뒤에 올 수 없어요

en: [[The artist]] [[spent]] [[hours]] painting colors on the canvas and expressing strong emotions, creating a piece [[admired]] by critics around the world.
me: painting colors on the canvas and expressing strong emotions, creating a piece admired by critics around the world
easy: painting colors on the canvas and expressing strong emotions
캔버스에 색을 칠하고 강한 감정을 표현하며.
a piece admired by critics around the world
전 세계 평론가들에게 찬사를 받는 작품.
요약: 화가가 오랜 시간 그려 평론가들이 칭찬하는 작품을 만들었다.
notes: 명사 뒤에서 꾸밀 때: 명사가 동작을 '받으면' 과거분사(-ed). a piece(작품)는 찬사를 '받는' 쪽 → admired(admire 칭찬하다)
명사가 직접 하면 -ing. 예: a girl singing(노래하는 소녀)

en: After a long day at work, [[Sally]] [[goes]] for a run to clear her mind or takes a warm bath, since exercise makes her feel [[as good as]] a relaxing bath does.
me: After a long day at work,
for a run to clear her mind or takes a warm bath, since exercise makes her feel as good as a relaxing bath does
easy: After a long day at work
to clear her mind or takes a warm bath
마음을 정리하려고, 아니면 따뜻한 목욕을 한다.
since exercise makes her feel as good as a relaxing bath does
운동이 편안한 목욕만큼 기분 좋게 해 주기 때문에.
요약: 힘든 하루 후 달리기나 목욕으로 기분을 푼다.
notes: as + 원래 형용사 + as = ~만큼 …한: as good as. 비교급 better는 쓰면 안 돼요
예: as tall as(~만큼 키 큰)
feel good = 기분이 좋다 (feel + 형용사)

en: [[The book]] [[is filled]] with both inspiring and pleasing stories for all kinds of readers, stories written both to entertain and [[teach]] valuable life lessons.
me: with both inspiring and pleasing stories for all kinds of readers, stories written both to entertain and teach valuable life lessons
easy: with both inspiring and pleasing stories
stories written both to entertain and teach valuable life lessons
즐거움을 주고 소중한 교훈도 가르치려고 쓰인 이야기.
요약: 즐겁고 교훈도 주는 이야기가 가득한 책이다.
notes: both A and B는 A, B가 같은 모양: both to entertain(즐겁게 하다) and (to) teach(가르치다) → 동사원형
teaching(-ing)은 앞의 to entertain과 모양이 달라요

en: As soon as the teacher entered the room, [[the students]] [[stopped]] [[talking]] and sat quietly in their seats, [[as]] they had been trained to behave from the very first day of school.
me: As soon as the teacher entered the room,
and sat quietly in their seats, as they had been trained to behave from the very first day of school
easy: As soon as the teacher entered the room
as they had been trained to behave from the very first day
요약: 선생님이 들어오자 학생들이 훈련된 듯 조용히 앉았다.
notes: like는 전치사라 뒤에 명사만. 주어+동사(절) 앞에는 접속사 as를 써요
예: like a bird(새처럼) / as they had been trained(그들이 훈련받은 것처럼)
stop + -ing = ~하는 것을 멈추다

en: [[Put]] [[your plans]] down on paper not only to help with brainstorming but also to make your thoughts clear, a habit that continues benefiting your focus and [[improving]] your memory over time.
me: down on paper not only to help with brainstorming but also to make your thoughts clear, a habit that continues benefiting your focus and improving your memory over time
easy: on paper not only to help with brainstorming but also to make your thoughts clear
브레인스토밍을 돕고 생각을 명확히 하려고 종이에.
a habit that continues benefiting your focus
and improving your memory over time
요약: 종이에 계획을 적는 습관은 집중력과 기억력에 도움이 된다.
notes: continue + -ing: continues benefiting(benefit 도움이 되다) and improving(improve 향상시키다) → and 앞뒤 모양 같게
continue는 to부정사/동명사 둘 다 받지만, 여기서는 benefiting과 짝이니 improving

en: To become a good writer, practice writing daily and seek feedback from other people, and [[each of the successful habits]] [[requires]] [[patience]] to build.
key: 그 습관들 각각은 인내심을 필요로 한다.
me: To become a good writer, practice writing daily and seek feedback from other people, and
easy: each of the habits requires patience
그 습관들 각각은 인내심을 필요로 한다.
To become a good writer, practice writing daily and seek feedback
좋은 작가가 되려면 매일 글쓰기를 연습하고 피드백을 구하라.
요약: 좋은 작가가 되는 습관은 하나하나 인내심이 필요하다.
notes: each of + 복수명사는 단수 취급: each ~ requires(require 필요로 하다) (require ✕)
핵심은 of 앞의 each. of 뒤 복수명사(habits)에 속지 말기

en: [[Listening to others]] [[allows]] [[you]] [[to solve problems, gain new views, and learn from different experiences]], experiences that shape your character and [[help]] you grow as a person.
key: 다른 사람의 말을 듣는 것은 당신이 …할 수 있게 해 준다.
me: to solve problems, gain new views, and learn from different experiences
, experiences that shape your character and help you grow as a person
easy: Listening to others allows you to solve problems
남의 말을 듣는 것은 당신이 문제를 해결할 수 있게 해 준다.
gain new views, and learn from different experiences
새 시각을 얻고 다양한 경험에서 배울 수도 있다.
and help you grow as a person
요약: 경청하면 문제도 풀고 배우며, 그 경험이 나를 성장시킨다.
notes: 관계대명사절 안의 동사끼리 병렬: that shape(형성하다) ~ and help(돕다) → 같은 모양(동사원형). helping ✕
allow A to 동사원형 = A가 ~하게 해 주다 (5형식)

en: [[My cat]] [[tries]] [[to catch birds in the garden]] but fails every time, and [[returns]] inside looking rather disappointed.
me: to catch birds in the garden
but fails every time, and returns inside looking rather disappointed
easy: My cat tries to catch birds
and returns inside looking rather disappointed
그리고 다소 실망한 표정으로 안으로 돌아온다.
요약: 고양이는 새를 못 잡고 실망해서 돌아온다.
notes: and로 이어진 동사는 같은 모양: tries, fails, returns (모두 주어 My cat 뒤 현재형 -s)
returning은 혼자서 동사가 못 돼요 → return(돌아오다)의 -s형 returns

en: [[The CEO]] [[agrees]] with delaying the store opening and taking more time to prepare for the event, as if he [[were]] fully aware of every risk involved from the very beginning.
me: with delaying the store opening and taking more time to prepare for the event
, as if he were fully aware of every risk involved from the very beginning
easy: with delaying the store opening and taking more time to prepare
매장 개장을 미루고 준비할 시간을 더 갖는 것에.
as if he were fully aware of every risk
마치 그가 모든 위험을 충분히 알았던 것처럼.
요약: 위험을 다 아는 듯이, CEO는 개장을 미루자는 데 동의한다.
notes: as if + 과거형(가정) = 마치 ~인 것처럼(실제로는 아님). be동사는 모든 주어에 were: as if he were
예: He talks as if he were a king.(그는 마치 왕인 것처럼 말한다.)

en: [[Dora]] [[cannot tell]] [[if she is nervous or excited about taking her first plane ride]], a mix of feelings that leaves her family [[amazed]] as they watch her prepare.
me: if she is nervous or excited about taking her first plane ride
, a mix of feelings that leaves her family amazed as they watch her prepare
easy: if she is nervous or excited about her first plane ride
leaves her family amazed as they watch her prepare
그녀가 준비하는 걸 볼 때 가족이 놀라게 만든다.
요약: 설렘과 긴장이 섞여, 지켜보는 가족도 놀란다.
notes: 사람이 감정을 '느끼면' -ed: her family(가족)는 놀람을 느끼는 쪽 → amazed(amaze 놀라게 하다의 과거분사)
감정을 '일으키는' 쪽(일이나 물건)이면 -ing. 예: an amazing show(놀라운 쇼)
